split.source: official LRGB split (torch_geometric.datasets.LRGBDataset, splits train / val / test)

frozen.checkpoint_rule: best validation MAE (lowest value; strict improvement, first epoch on ties); raw and EMA weights each use their own validation curve
frozen.report_metric: test MAE (lower is better) of the checkpoint chosen on validation MAE

published_gps.source: GraphGPS paper (Rampasek et al., NeurIPS 2022), LRGB table

accepted_exceptions.name: learning sanity: training loss on 256 graphs over 20 epochs (both arms)
accepted_exceptions.decision: accepted as a documented exception by the user on 2026-11-22 (the rule and its 50% threshold are unchanged; the failure and the evidence are recorded)
accepted_exceptions.evidence: tests/output/peptides_struct_check11_diagnostic.json: GPS_ema: training-mode loss before any update 0.693, after the 20 epochs 0.319 (-54%); epoch means 0.512 -> 0.369 (-28%, the quantity of check 11); eval-mode loss 8.38 -> 0.446; PairHGT: training-mode loss before any update 0.692, after the 20 epochs 0.318 (-54%); epoch means 0.503 -> 0.366 (-27%, the quantity of check 11); eval-mode loss 8.40 -> 0.382. Both arms behave alike; the L1 loss and the MAE metric pass checks 2 and 3. Most of the drop happens inside epoch 1 (standardised targets), so the epoch-mean comparison of check 11 understates the learning.
